title: Cooperative delivery orders
bodyMd:
The cooperative counts each order once. A delivered order is an order that arrived within the reporting week; cancellation is included among orders not delivered.

| Category | Orders | Delivered |
|---|---:|---:|
| Village | 50 | 40 |
| Town | 100 | 70 |
| Harbour | 150 | 135 |
